summary: RHDH sends telemetry to Red Hat via the `backstage-plugin-analytics-provider-segment` plug-in, enabled by default and including Ansible plug-in data: page visits and clicks, system and page info, anonymized IPs (0.0.0.0) and username hashes, and feedback form ratings when that form is enabled.
questions: What telemetry does Developer Hub send to Red Hat?
How do I disable telemetry in RHDH?
Do the Ansible plug-ins collect usage data?
